text: X2F is a place where like-minded, privacy focused individuals or groups come together to exchange hard earned XMR currency for the payment method that suits them. Vice versa, it is also equally for those that wish to purchase XMR and pay for it in way that is easiest or most convenient to them. X2F just brings those people together and let's them interact safely & securely with a built in escrow system and moderators to resolve disputes if ever such one should happen.

I like what you have as well "X2F is a place where people trade Monero (XMR) for cash, bank transfers and payment apps with each other. X2F is a facilitator. It is not a party to your trades, it is not a bank or an exchange, and it never holds your coins". Find a way to marry them without overlap.
You need an account to trade or post an ad but with X2F being completely privacy focused you are never asked for an email address or a phone number.
Keep your login details and recovery codes safe and private. While your wallet and funds may be secure, your account age and reputation are irreplaceable

X2F has no way to reset them for you, so if you lose them you may lose the account without a way to recover it but we provide you with ample highly secure methods to protect sanctity of your account. Your coins stay safe in your own wallet either way.

...instantly undone, but it can be disputed and funds recovered, to the best of our abilities for the slighted party. Hopefully the moderator will end the trade amicably and it will end as a normal trade but in the event things aren't so straight forward our team is here to help.
....to mark the trade paid using the payment method requested.

If the allotted time has run out then whoever started the trade can immediately cancel and receive the funds from escrow deposited back into their account. If the clock has nearly run out always make sure to:

• Send the payment as requested and mark it paid thus preventing any ability for the other party to cancel when the time has run out. 

• Communicate with the other trader and let them know you may be delayed in sending as to prevent them from having their fingers on the cancellation button at first opportunity they get.

• Stay in contact with them and respond when reached out to or if you are the one not getting a response feel free to send an audio cue, what we like to call a "nudge" to grab their attention.
Add this in bullet form to my previous comment - If you paid late and the seller cancels, open a dispute and we will help you get your money back. The trade screen always shows the time left.
Whoever posts the ad pays is responsible for the bill which will be automatically deducted, pending the completion of the trade. We don't get paid unless you both do.
Responding to someone else’s ad is always free. You are a trader or a vendor.
If either party is not satisfied with the outcome of the dispute, an appeal can be requested in which a senior moderator will decide the final binding decision.
A moderator’s goal is ultimately to see a trade through to completion.
.....the same as though the trade never happened to begin with.

Because of the changes above we really only need to say here "An appeal can be requested only once per dispute and as mentioned decisions are final and binding. Our moderators are incredibly fair and we are confident that we will find the outcome that is best for everyone.

X2F only provides access to completed trades for 30 days, after which the entirety of the trade is purged. The only exception to this is if there is a dispute, in which case the dispute is kept for 90 days after completion after being scrubbed with our internal privacy tool and used for training moderators. At the 90 day mark it is all purged, no exceptions.
Keep all of this - X2F does not track you, does not use analytics and removes location and device details from uploads.
